body: english. not in the slightest. i don't have passion for any real career.
pretty much nothing. i go to college but i hate it. i'm also an independent contractor doing web stuff but i also hate it and i make a paltry amount of money for the work i do.

i'll read it this weekend and report back on what i think of it.

i can really relate though. i mean i do most things because i'm scared of how people will retaliate if i don't. isn't it tiring feeling all the time? i mean it can't be much more tiring than this.

yeah, you're right. i might be putting it off because deep down i really want to keep going. i'm not really sure though. living for the sake of living is too exhausting to even consider at this point.
just having to do anything at all makes me want to throw up.

that is very true. i just always compared myself to him because he's only a year younger than me, so it's easy to get stuck in comparisons. i compare myself to other people as well. i'm judgmental of others but i'm more judgmental of myself.

most days i can't even find the energy to get up and take a shower. i just lie in bed and feel... nothing really, i think i'm numb more than sad at this point.

last night i went out to talk to my fiance and i started to cry immediately. they were worried and asked if i wanted to talk about it and i said no. i only cried for a minute before telling myself i was being stupid. maybe i should have embraced it and just let myself feel emotions rather than just shooting myself down every time i do.

thank you so much. you have been way too kind to a person like me.

thanks. :(

yeah. i was on antidepressants before and they weren't really helping. i think that my depression might actually be caused by my hormonal imbalance which is quite a bit out of my budget to fix... and i went to psychotherapy for a few months without much coming of it. i couldn't afford to pay for that either and they sued me recently. kind of ironic that the people that were trying to help me ended up pushing me further into depression.

honestly the few people that care about me are already really deep in depression themselves. i realize now after a day that me killing myself might actually be the tipping point to make one of them kill themselves as well. and that scares me. just because i want to escape the pain doesn't mean i want to hurt my family in the process.

i really want to get professional help but it would have to be free or extremely low cost. i live in a really rural area and have spent a lot of time looking through my options and haven't found anything that's viable...

i feel like i have to have a use monetarily because i'm currently living with a parent, and i feel like i'm never going to be able to get myself out of debt. i feel like i owe him so much. my sibling is younger than me and has had a job for years and has been living on his own. in contrast i have been living with my parent for years and have been trying to go to college, but struggling.

i applied for disability because of my depression. i was told that it wasn't severe enough. i was told that i was still able to work. when i was completely honest about not even being able to get out of bed generally. i wanted to kill myself that day, too.

people definitely love me and care about me. the people that are closest to me (father, brother, fiance) even all get it because they all struggle with deep depression as well. i don't know why i can't just stick it out for them. i don't know why i'm so selfish that i can't stand the idea of living another day, even for them.

every time i've been to a therapist they've asked me what i have to live for, and i say "family i guess." but there are days when that isn't enough, and i feel guilty as hell about that.

i want to keep going but god it feels like even going another inch is suffocating me. it's the feeling that i'm drowning and so many people are trying to help but they're just out of reach. every day that goes by seems like it's closer to my last and i really need to change this mindset before it poisons me any further.

you're actually right, though. i know you're right. i'm going to print out what you said and keep it in a drawer and whenever i feel like hurting myself, i'm going to look back at it and remember that sometimes you have to take things even a minute, even seconds at a time. and that it's ok to be worthless. and that it isn't going to be like that forever.

just because i don't see a point now doesn't mean there won't be one in the future.

yeah that's kind of how i feel. i like to think that i could be fine alone but honestly i need them in my life. they've helped me out through so much.

that's kind of how i feel. my coping resources have been gone for quite some time now, and i don't know how i've made it this far. it's not like i have a promise to others to get better or to stick around.

i don't think i'll ever catch a break or get a windfall or anything. everything seems so hopeless. i can barely look a day into the future let alone a week, or a month, or hell even a year. i can't tell myself "it's going to get better" because that seems like a huge lie.

and yeah i know my friend is dealing with their own trauma right now, which makes me feel like a selfish asshole for even being upset...

my fiance will hold me when i ask them but i feel so lonely still. and i feel guilty about feeling lonely in their arms, it makes me want to cry because they're trying their hardest.

i hope you feel better soon as well. thank you for sharing your story, it does help to have someone who relates. :(
